title: XShell Command Implementation
description: Describes the implementation object of an XShell Command.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema used to validate this Command.

contract.description: Public contract of the Command, including its execute method.

types.description: Reusable named types scoped to the Command contract.

execute.description: Contract of the Command's execute method.

controller.description: Factory called with Command runtime dependencies and invocation context; must return an object implementing execute().
